ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Shim Database Persistence via Sdbinst.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects installation of a new shim using sdbinst.exe.
Adversaries may establish persistence and/or elevate privileges by executing malicious content triggered by application shims

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sdbinst\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "sdbinst\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sdb.*")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\IIS\\ Express\\\\iisexpressshim\\\.sdb.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\IIS\\ Express\\\\iisexpressshim\\\.sdb.*"))))
